messages:
Samira Patel: Hey team — I just accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows it on the 16th instead of the 15th. Is this the DST change? :thinking_face:
Maya Huang: Hi @Samira, are you on Google Calendar or Outlook? We sent the invite with UTC times so some clients shift when daylight savings applies.
Samira Patel: Google Calendar (G Suite). Invite shows 10:00 AM but the event detail says 15:00 UTC which would be 11am my time (I'm in Europe/Berlin). Kind of confusing.
Jon Reyes: Google sometimes displays the local converted time and also the original time in event details. Do you have "Event time zone" set on the invite?
Samira Patel: I can't see a timezone field in the event on mobile. On desktop I see the invite: starts 2024-11-15 10:00 (Europe/Berlin) but the ICS file has DTSTART:20241115T090000Z — that looks off?
Priya Kapoor: Quick check — if DTSTART is 090000Z that is 09:00 UTC = 10:00 CET, which should be correct for Berlin in Nov. But DST end can make this look one hour different depending on how the client interprets it.
Maya Huang: Thanks @Priya. To be safe: the official orientation time is 10:00 Europe/Berlin on Nov 15. We have two regional repeats so some recipients will see a different date if their client auto-adjusts.
Samira Patel: OK thanks. Will the recording be posted in the onboarding drive after? If I miss it due to this confusion I want the recording.
EngOnboardingBot: Recording will be uploaded to /onboarding/recordings within 2 hours after the session. Notification: https://files.redwood.ai/onboarding/recordings (will post file link). :white_check_mark:
Maya Huang: I'll re-send a clarified ICS with explicit start/end time zones and include "TZID=Europe/Berlin" fields. Also adding a note in the invite description: "Time shown is Europe/Berlin (CET/CEST depending on DST)."
Jon Reyes: If anyone on Outlook sees a duplicate event, decline one and keep the one with the location "Orientation - Main" (that's the canonical one).
Samira Patel: Great — thanks. Please @Maya ping here when you've re-sent so I can double-check. :pray:
Maya Huang: Will do. Resent now (1719999999.002). Added explicit TZ and a link to the recording folder. Let me know if any other timezones look wrong.
Samira Patel: Got it, looks correct now (shows Nov 15 10:00 CET). Thanks all! :tada:
